plans.idea: Classic left-to-right leaderboard: brand lockup opens, the bottle sits next to it as a product anchor, the headline and subhead get a wide central band, and the NEW VIDEO badge closes the strip on the right like a call-to-action chip instead of hiding under the copy.

Product-first: the bottle leads at the far left, the headline block runs straight after it, and the strip ends with a grouped brand sign-off where the badge and logo sit side by side, so the right end is filled on purpose instead of left empty.

Editorial kicker: the NEW VIDEO badge sits in front of the headline as its label, the copy follows it, then the bottle, and the logo locks up the right edge, so the strip reads badge → headline → product → brand.
